description: Mark Browserbase's secrets sensitive so they decode as Redacted. The webhook signing secret (`whsec_…`) is returned only by createWebhook and rotateWebhookSecret; the spec says "HMAC-SHA256 signing secret … Shown once here; store it now." A session's `signingKey` ("Signing key to use when connecting to the Session via HTTP") authenticates the connection to that browser, on createSession and getSession.
